suggested_change: Clarify carry-forward rules: (1) Define when 'no new information' must be explicitly stated vs. implied silence; (2) Set minimum evidence bar for competition scores (currently 5/10 requires evidence but threshold is unclear); (3) Separate 'carry-forward consistency check' from 'component completeness'—don't penalize both in same iteration; (4) Define acceptable specificity level for next steps ('map out' vs. exact Q&A format) with examples, not binary rejection.
